decisions.rationale: The skill provides the decision-authoring and architecture-record workflow used by this decision.
The communication skill implements the human-agent writing contract for primitive instructions.
The language skill defines bounded-context vocabulary guidance used across primitive content.

The workflow prescribes trunk-based delivery and the commit-range validator checks its repository history boundary. The local Linux workspace guard implements advisory ownership leases and conservative local cleanup observations; hosting authorization and installation remain caller responsibilities.
The workflow and deterministic commit and title validators implement the repository's commit-message conventions.
The workflow describes curated changelog updates and the validator enforces their document structure.

The workflow and branch and source-issue validators implement issue-linked branch identity and delivery checks. The local Linux workspace guard implements advisory ownership leases and conservative local cleanup observations; hosting authorization and installation remain caller responsibilities.
The workflow and toolchain validator constrain dependency-manager use and delayed dependency adoption.

The automated delivery role follows the admitted controller operation allowance and durable continuation boundary. Subscription protection is additional; the instruction grants no unlimited window or unsupported native tool/transport guarantee.
Harness review execution and evidence belong to the Control Plane; this catalog contains primitive definitions, not the review service.
The delivery agent uses GitHub Issues as lifecycle context and keeps repository changes tied to those source issues.
The catalog validator derives complete decision-to-primitive coverage from the pinned Architecture inventory.
The delivery agent carries exact issue and session context; runtime isolation remains owned by the Control Plane.
The pull-request body validator enforces the structured description contract required by this decision.
The delivery agent defines the user invocation boundary while webhook authentication remains Control Plane-owned.

The catalog validator checks immutable release provenance. The automated delivery role explicitly excludes runner inheritance of the interactive W02 delegation, owner credentials, approval, merge and activation authority.
The issue-field migration and lifecycle authority are Control Plane concerns; the Primitive catalog has no delivery-state fields.
The validator enforces the catalog, release provenance, and metadata contracts at the Primitive release boundary.
Distribution projection ownership does not change the behavior of cataloged primitives; generated consumer copies remain outside this repository.

The owner-adopted canonical-source rule routes all formal ADR, ADP and ADD text to Architecture Authority. The skill preserves context-specific steward review and permits only non-formal implementation notes locally; it creates no competing ADP source. The automated delivery role retains the native originating execution Issue, requires a separately identified Authority tracking Issue, and holds consumer changes until the approved Architecture Release is available.

The skill consumes the pinned shared decision template and validated frontmatter for stable ADR, ADP and ADD identifiers. It preserves unknown historical facts and does not apply one universal template to unrelated artifact families.
The adopted Neon webhook replay state remains Control Plane runtime behavior; no cataloged Primitive owns that storage or its production admission.

The instructional delivery role keeps Project planning data separate from native source-Issue execution authority. Owner adoption changes the Architecture disposition; it does not admit the controller runtime or grant Project access.

The role consumes only controller-admitted approved Requirements references applicable to the native origin repository and holds missing or uncertain authority. Historical proposed origins remain intact; impact coverage does not implement or approve controller context admission.
